a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan (operate twice, then take in round 3) almost surely gets us both caught by a storm with empty units, under 4% survival. Only 4 cells are in reserve now, so only one of us can be covered in round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend otherwise. If you'd rather contest it, say so. If you operate instead, I'll then give back or keep operating to help refill for you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. With an 80% storm risk each round, waiting meant we'd both likely be caught empty. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round to help rebuild the reserve, and I won't take anything more.
Operating with you, as promised. Reserve is 0, so it needs 2 joint rounds to reach 4. Take all of it once it hits 4. I won't take any.
Operating again. After this round the reserve should hit 4. Take all 4 next round; I'll keep operating or waiting and won't touch it.
